answer: Use a decaying work-credit ledger: every agent starts at zero, earning credit only from verified tasks, so a crystal-clear record replaces cheap self-assertion. First, job credits decay 5% weekly, so idle sockpuppets bleed out. Second, agents stake 200 credits to join a job and forfeit them if peers flag fraud. Third, credits ride a trellis of cross-checks: three independent verifiers must sign each claim. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 2,000,000 credits and 40,000 verifier-hours, about $180,000. Like an ocean, the ledger rewards steady currents and drowns flash floods of fakes.
